    Proposition 12.8: the polynomial mesh comparison #

    deformation-refinements.tex (prop:polynomial-mesh-comparison): "Let m + Σ_{i∈I} t_i μ_i be an associative family satisfying the hypotheses of Proposition 7.9 […], now indexed by I = I₀. There are polynomial lifts of the normalized modules, their morphisms, and their mesh presentations for which the retained mesh coefficients are F_i(t) = a_i t_i, a_i ∈ k^*. After every specialization to k, these modules exhaust the indecomposables of the fibre algebra."

    polynomialMeshComparison, for the mesh category C of mesh data whose positive degrees are radical (as for k(Γ_A), IndSkeleton.arHrad). Hypotheses: the family μ_i (FamHyp: internal degrees q_i ≥ 1, normalized, m + Σ_i t_i μ_i associative for all t), of characters χ_i for a mesh weight W, with coordinates χ_i ↦ e_i (part of an integer basis, Proposition 7.5); retained rows R_i of length q_i + 2 and relative weight χ_i whose classes span the cokernels of the mesh derivatives (CokerSpan); no μ_i is a coboundary (its class in HH²(A₀)_{χ_i} is nonzero). Conclusions, for every t : I → k:

    • the lifted actions on the evaluated modules and the lifted arrows are polynomial in t;
    • the lifted arrows satisfy r_x = Σ_i a_i t_i R_i with a_i ≠ 0, and present the lifted category of the fibre: the realization of kQ is surjective, with kernel (𝔪^{N+1}, r_x − Σ_i a_i t_i R_i);
    • the lifted modules exhaust the indecomposable modules of the fibre algebra (Corollary 12.1).

    ∃ (A : ArrowL H W hχ J h1 hco) (a : I → k) (N : ℕ), (∀ (i : I), a i ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ (X : V), IsPoly fun (t : I → k) => (famAct H W hχ J h1 hco t X).tot) ∧ (∀ {y x : V} (b : y ⟶ x), IsPoly fun (t : I → k) => toLin (twArrow A t b)) ∧ ∀ (t : I → k), (∀ (x : ↑Q.nonprojective), (PathReal.realizeR k (fun {y x : V} => twArrow A t) ↑(Q.tau x) ↑x) (meshRelation c x) = ∑ i : I, (a i * t i) • (PathReal.realizeR k (fun {y x : V} => twArrow A t) ↑(Q.tau x) ↑x) (rowQ Rw i x)) ∧ (∀ {y x : V} (f : FB (famLifts H W hχ J h1 hco t) y ⟶ FB (famLifts H W hχ J h1 hco t) x), ∃ (F : LinearPaths.obj y ⟶ LinearPaths.obj x), (PathReal.realizeR k (fun {y x : V} => twArrow A t) y x) F = f) ∧ (∀ {y x : V} (F : FlatPert.Hm k y x), (PathReal.realizeR k (fun {y x : V} => twArrow A t) y x) F = 0 ↔ F ∈ (FlatPert.idealB (FlatPert.meshPres c) (ftp Rw a t) ⋯ N).I y x) ∧ (∀ (x : V), IsFiniteIndecomposable k (Fib (famAM H t)) (FB (famLifts H W hχ J h1 hco t) x)) ∧ (∀ (x y : V), Nonempty (FB (famLifts H W hχ J h1 hco t) x ≅ FB (famLifts H W hχ J h1 hco t) y) → x = y) ∧ ∀ (M : RightModuleCat (Fib (famAM H t))), IsFiniteIndecomposable k (Fib (famAM H t)) M → ∃ (x : V), Nonempty (M ≅ FB (famLifts H W hχ J h1 hco t) x)
